neighbours.label: A position inside a regular repeated list pattern (bullet items, delimited code lists, dated log lines) where the next item is predictable, vs the same tokens in running prose
fire: Codes: NY · NJ · PA · OH · MI · IN · IL

predictions: Bulleted or delimited lists 0.3-0.7; the same items mentioned once in prose under 0.1.
short: item inside a repeated list pattern
notes: Card: peaks on ',', '-', digits inside sequences ([0, 1, 2], 1..9, AK · AL, dated lists, number columns). Probe: 'AK · AL · AR' 0.656, bullet country list 0.661, dated bullet lines 0.495, '1, 2, ..., 9' 0.299; numbers in prose 0.015-0.019, items[1] = code 0.063 (not reproduced).
